data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger operates in the Defense & Security sector and is currently public. The company has raised $22M+ as of 2025. The Defense & Security comp universe encompasses 21 same-sector peers, including 2 publicly traded companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms such as Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security peer set, while containing 21 total comparable companies, does not yield a sufficient narrow peer cohort meeting standard filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier combinations); only 1 same-stage peer was identified, falling below the three-datapoint minimum required for robust peer-median triangulation. Reliance on an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity in Defense & Security business models, revenue scales, and risk profiles.

The limited applicability of quantitative triangulation methods means this valuation rests primarily on qualitative assessment of the broader public and private comp landscape. Key uncertainties include Thunder Tiger's current revenue scale, profitability trajectory, and differentiation within the fragmented Defense & Security ecosystem relative to better-capitalized competitors like Anduril and Shield AI. A credible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data without additional financial metrics on the target and peer benchmarks.
